reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis links residual stress and grain size to passive film stability, which is scientifically sound, but it oversimplifies by assuming larger grains and lower stress always improve tribo-corrosion resistance, ignoring that fine grains can enhance hardness and passive film formation in some HEAs.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific measurements and a falsification criterion, but the heat treatment durations (5 vs 15 min at 1100°C) may not produce a stark enough microstructural contrast to decisively isolate the governing cause.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key gap in tribo-corrosion of HEAs and proposes a controlled comparison, but it focuses narrowly on one alloy and processing route, limiting its broader applicability to the large compositional space of HEAs.
